messages:
rachel-docs: Opened a small PR to standardize export metadata examples and add a CSV sample auditors can use. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812 :wave:

dmitri-compliance: Thanks. Two quick asks: use `actor_id` in examples to match our SOC2 templates, and change any "should be encrypted" phrasing to "must be encrypted at rest and in transit". Also auditors like CSV samples for evidence manifests.

rachel-docs: Draft includes a CSV manifest sample and a JSON schema. CSV shows columns: event, actor_id, resource, evidence_ref, timestamp. Example line I put in draft: "audit_export,acct-9876,audit/export/2026-03-02,REDACTED_EVIDENCE_URI,2026-03-02T12:00:00Z". Thoughts?

paul-eng: Can we avoid any example that looks like a real bucket path? Replace with `REDACTED_EVIDENCE_URI`. For the JSON schema, prefer `evidence_ref` rather than `export_uri` and add migration note. Also add a short Postgres migration snippet to rewrite `export_uri` -> `evidence_ref` and strip query params. I can paste sample SQL.

rachel-docs: Added migration SQL as internal-only snippet in the draft and marked it "internal". Public docs will only link to migration KB. The SQL is tiny: ```sql
UPDATE exports SET evidence_ref = 'REDACTED_EVIDENCE_URI' WHERE evidence_ref IS NULL;
```

anya-legal: Please mark all URIs as placeholders and include a sentence: "Do not publish full storage URIs in public docs; reference placeholders and provide retrieval steps internally." Also add a one-line sanitized vs unsanitized example.

dmitri-compliance: Also add explicit retention defaults (hosted=90d, dedicated=365d, private=customer-configurable) in the doc and clarify that retention overrides require an export_policy setting and approval. And add a footnote recommending KMS rotation every 90 days for high-sensitivity evidence.

rachel-docs: Done. I included a small table with defaults and a migration note: "If you previously used `export_uri` in logs or exports, run the internal sanitize tool before sharing manifests. See internal KB."

paul-eng: For the CSV sample, include a header row and show that `evidence_ref` should be a placeholder. Example I suggested:

```csv
event,actor_id,resource,evidence_ref,timestamp
audit_export,acct-9876,audit/exports/2026,Q_REDACTED_EVIDENCE_URI,2026-03-02T12:00:00Z
```

rachel-docs: Updated CSV in PR with header and placeholder value. Also added a tiny Node SDK snippet showing pagination and safe logging of `export.id` only.

anya-legal: Wording approved once "must be encrypted" and placeholders are in place. Add a short sentence about removing embedded credentials from metadata.

dmitri-compliance: LGTM. Please ensure the public doc uses the SOC2 tone ("must") and that internal migration scripts remain internal.

ci-bot: docs CI passed for PR #812 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812/commits/1a2b3c).

rachel-docs: Thanks everyone 12I'll merge once lint passes and schedule a tiny patch release. Changelog: "standardize export manifest samples (CSV/JSON), clarify retention and redaction guidance".

paul-eng: Quick follow-up: I left a tiny comment about adding an example curl for the export policy API. Not required for merge but helpful.

rachel-docs: Noted, will add in next patch. Merging now. :tada:
